name: Open World
author: Jeffiest
description: Dark Cloud as one world to walk, built in steps (OPEN_WORLD_PLAN.md). So far, for any story save: no loading card on the way from one place to another, a town's dungeon seen through its door; a dungeon's floors joined into maps you walk through, with no stairs scenes; and a town's gate is the road to the next town, wherever the story has opened the way.

settings.name: No loading card on the way from one place to another
Walk from floor to floor: no stairs scenes, floors joined by gates
A town's gate is the road to the next town, not the world map
The road only leads where the story has opened the way
